title: Warn when /pr-loop is missing or out of date, and refuse a review without it
notes:
The review loop runs /pr-loop (GitHub) or /mr-loop (GitLab) (src/main/ship/review.ts:167), which come from a separate checkout, naeemba/claude-pr-loop, linked into ~/.claude/commands by its install.sh. Nothing checks it: a missing install sends a review worker into a command that does not exist, and an out-of-date one runs old behaviour silently.
Do:
1. Missing: when a review would start, refuse it with the reason and the install line (git clone naeemba/claude-pr-loop && ./install.sh) if ~/.claude/commands/<pr|mr>-loop.md is not there. Export the predicate from where the refusal is decided (errors-rule-1).
2. Out of date: on app start and on each review start, show the app's notice when (a) the linked checkout is behind its origin default branch (fetch at most once a day), or (b) the copied workflow file ~/.claude/workflows/*.js differs from the checkout's (install.sh copies it, so a git pull alone leaves it stale), or (c) a command link is dangling. The notice says what to run.
3. Test the decision module. Docs in docs/ship.
Do not bundle the commands into the app: the repo is used on its own too. Requested by the user 2026-11-17.

comments.body: Pull request #324 opened: Refuse a review without /pr-loop, and warn when it is out of date https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/324
